name: Crossref REST API
description: Metadata for ~165 million DOIs registered by publishers - titles, authors, dates, funders, licences, references where the publisher deposits them. The registration authority for most scholarly DOIs, so it is the authoritative answer to 'what is this DOI'.

license.name: metadata is open (CC0-equivalent facts); abstracts carry publisher terms

access.auth_note: anonymous works; adding mailto= puts you in the polite pool with far better latency
access.size_hint: annual public data file is ~185 GB compressed
access.rate_limit: published in the X-Rate-Limit-Limit response header, typically 50/second in the polite pool

recipes.title: Resolve a DOI to structured metadata

gotchas.trap: Reference lists are only present when the publisher deposited them, which is roughly 60% of works and heavily skewed by publisher.
gotchas.fix: Check is-referenced-by-count and reference-count separately; absence is not evidence of no citations.

gotchas.trap: Titles and abstracts arrive as arrays and may carry JATS XML tags inside the string.
gotchas.fix: Take element [0] and strip tags before indexing text.
